query_text: what is the max amount you can collect for unemployment in mass

action.query: Massachusetts unemployment maximum weekly benefit amount 2026

content.text:
In **Massachusetts**, the current **maximum unemployment benefit** is **$1,105 per week** for regular unemployment insurance, as of **October 5, 2025**. Massachusetts says your weekly benefit is generally about **50% of your average weekly wage**, up to that legal maximum. ([mass.gov](https://www.mass.gov/info-details/how-unemployment-insurance-benefits-are-determined?utm_source=openai))

A couple of important notes:

- **Maximum duration:** usually up to **30 weeks** in Massachusetts. ([mass.gov](https://www.mass.gov/info-details/how-unemployment-insurance-benefits-are-determined?utm_source=openai))  
- **Possible dependent allowance:** if you support dependent children, you may get **$25 per dependent child per week**, capped at **50% of your weekly benefit amount**.  
- Don’t confuse this with **PFML** — Massachusetts Paid Family and Medical Leave has a different 2026 maximum of **$1,230.39/week**, but that is not regular unemployment. ([mass.gov](https://www.mass.gov/info-details/how-pfml-weekly-benefit-amounts-are-calculated-andor-changed?utm_source=openai))
